title: Verbatim promotion: byte-identical code plus legitimate decoupling
subject: verbatim-promotion
ratio:
**Verbatim promotion (P-026)**: when the winner is promoted into production, "verbatim"
means algorithm **byte-identical** PLUS legitimate decoupling from its candidate
harness — candidate-identifying strings/prefixes renamed, the candidate's own
self-test/`__main__` block stripped, and zero runtime `require`/`import` of anything
under `candidates/`.
dicta:
Precedent: T-049's promoted `lib/schedule.js` is byte-identical to
`schedule_b.js` except two renamed error-message prefixes (`schedule_b:` →
`schedule:`), with the self-check guard dropped and no runtime dependency on
`candidates/` (`events.jsonl` T-049 verdict note, "PROMOTION FIDELITY").
scope_conditions: role:worker or role:verifier promoting a tournament/consensus candidate under a projects/*/candidates/ directory into production code
tournament/consensus topology promotions only (ORCHESTRATION.md section 5); does not extend to ordinary fan-out/join merges with a single candidate
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a tournament promotion is ever verdicted 'verbatim' without a byte-diff actually being run against the promoted file's candidate source.
validity_conditions: promotion to ORCHESTRATION.md quotes the note verbatim rather than paraphrasing
